## Summary
Jordan, your performance shows a strong consistency in customer satisfaction with a CSI score of 975 over the last three days. However, we need to focus on improving your hours per RO and upsell percentages to align more closely with industry standards.

## What's Working
- Your CSI score of 975 on May 30th reflects excellent customer service, maintaining a strong reputation for our dealership. 👏
- The daily average of 12.59 ROs is commendable, indicating that you're managing a healthy volume of customers.
- You've shown improvement in your hours per RO with a peak of 1.03 on May 26th, which is a positive trend to build upon.
- Your alignment upsell percentage peaked at 22.9% on May 19th, demonstrating your ability to identify additional service opportunities. 
- Overall, your effective communication with technicians has led to timely updates on ROs, which is crucial for maintaining workflow efficiency.

## Where to Focus
- Your hours per RO is currently averaging around 1.01, which is below the industry target of 1.2. This means there’s room for improvement in upselling services. Focus on discussing additional services with customers when they come in for repairs to boost this metric. 📈
- The alignment upsell percentage has fluctuated, with a recent drop to 13.1% on May 30th. Aim to re-engage customers about alignment services, especially if they mention any handling issues during their visit.
- Tire upsell percentage is at 10.7% on May 30th; consider incorporating tire health checks as a standard part of your service conversations to increase this number. 
- Your ELR is hovering around 89.9%, which is good, but we need to push for consistent improvement. Focus on ensuring that every vehicle is thoroughly diagnosed and that you’re communicating the value of repairs to customers. 
- Open ROs like 777425 (19 days old) and 777209 (26 days old) require timely follow-ups to keep customers informed and engaged, ensuring we maintain their trust.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Increase your upsell conversations by discussing alignment and tires with at least 5 customers this week, aiming for a minimum of 15% upsell on these services.
2. Follow up on open RO 777425 and 777209 to provide updates to customers, ensuring they feel valued and informed about their vehicle's status.
3. Review and strategize with the service team on how to improve hours per RO, targeting a goal of 1.2 by the end of the week.

## Open Work to Push
- Focus on RO 777425 (19 days old) and RO 777209 (26 days old), as they are aging and require customer communication. Keep the queue moving!
